description: Two changes, each with its own hypothesis: (1) state the two scored rules up front as output requirements instead of leaving them in a bullet list halfway down, and (2) bound the QA loop -- replace "USE SUBAGENTS" (no subagent exists here, and one would be a confound) and the open-ended "repeat until a full pass reveals no new issues" with a single render-and-check cycle. What the QA wording COSTS is then a measurable result about skill authoring.

ops.find: **⚠️ USE SUBAGENTS** — even for 2-3 slides. You've been staring at the code and will see what you expect, not what's there. Subagents have fresh eyes.
5. Repeat until a full pass reveals no new issues
